text: REJECT: `ExpressRouteTarget(...) is not var (path, receiver, middle)` is a `var` pattern with a tuple designation on a `Nullable<ValueTuple>`, and `var` patterns match everything including null, so the early `return null` can never fire. The deconstruction of a nullable tuple is also likely a compile error (CS8129), and if it did compile, the non-route case would no longer skip the call, so behaviour would change.
